title: Valley of Roses
description: Cardboard cutouts are put up by the Institute for Roses and Aromatic Plants, a research and agriculture academy in Kazanlak, Bulgaria to bring in tourists. Located in the Balkan Mountains in the center of what is known as the Valley of Roses, the town is famous for their rose oil production. Kazanlak holds a rose festival every June, where visitors can witness traditional rose picking and the distillation process alongside a parade and folk dances.
translated_description: 保加利亚卡赞勒克的玫瑰与芳香植物研究所（一家农业研究机构）设置了纸板人像，以吸引游客。这座小镇位于巴尔干山脉，地处著名的玫瑰谷中心，以玫瑰精油生产闻名。每年六月，卡赞勒克都会举办玫瑰节，游客可以观赏传统玫瑰采摘和蒸馏工艺，同时还能参与游行和民间舞蹈。
